=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The judge can ... merge ... push a fix ... or close_and_reissue. (The close_and_reissue action must maintain or reset security audit state).
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, close_and_reissue action path
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The security gate logic (rb_security_merge_gate) is only executed for merge/merge_with_followup/fix paths. There is no explicit handling in the close_and_reissue action path to ensure the newly reissued issue/PR carries over the security audit state or resets it appropriately, potentially allowing a reissued PR to bypass required security audit cycles; The PR description states the security-exhaustion judge may `close_and_reissue`. The new code adds the security gate for `merge`/`merge_with_followup` and for the `fix`-as-merge case at `IS_FINAL=true`, but the `close_and_reissue` arm (around scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines that the `case` statement branches into) is not surfaced in the diff. The new `single_pass_extensions` logic still treats any orphan extension marker on a reissued PR's head as part of the new PR's audit budget, so a closed-and-reissued PR with persistent findings could inherit cycles from its predecessor's unaudited fix commits without an explicit gate. The new logic does not add a guard ensuring the reissued issue's first cycle audits the new head rather than trusting inherited extension markers.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
